title: Dormant H=0 auxiliary factories lose all encoded entanglement by a fixed time
statement: The single-qubit Pauli bath has lambda_X=exp[-2(gamma_Y+gamma_Z)t] cyclically. It is EB iff sum lambda_P<=1, via a convex measure-and-prepare decomposition and the Choi Bell witness. Hence EB by t=log3/(4 gamma_min). Tensor powers, any preceding encoding and subsequent decoding cannot preserve unknown d-dimensional entanglement; unhalved diamond distance from identity is at least 2(1-1/d).
